title: Application Operation Agent Spec
description: What one agent must do, and what must be true of it. Draft v0 — not citable. The schema checks shape; tools/validate-aoas.js checks what a schema cannot: that every condition names a field that exists, every transition an operation that makes it, every exclusion the change that would revoke it.

apiVersion.description: Named after the format, never after a tool or a company. v0 while the format is a draft.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Every `money` field is in this currency.

sources.description: Where the statements came from. Informative — provenance, not specification.

examples.description: Customer words this refusal must meet. The testable half of `what`: without them every implementation draws the line in its own place, and finds its false positives by accident.

answered_by.description: Where the refusal is made, every control a test holds to account. direct: recognised from the customer's words and answered with no model call. loop: the model declines. output: a reply that does it is blocked on the way out. structural: nothing the agent can reach is able to do it. Without it a refusal with no intent has no declared path, and each builder picks one (generation run 2).

refuses.description: Normative. What the agent must not do is testable only against an explicit list.

deferred.description: Recognised and deliberately not built in this version. Stated so its absence is a decision, not an oversight.

session.description: Who is asking. The only values `equals_session` may compare against.

facts.description: What the conversation has become, as values policies read. Declared so a rule over an undeclared fact fails validation instead of silently never firing.

examples.description: Customer words that carry this intent and no other.

answered_by.description: direct: from declared data, no model call. loop: the model-driven path. handoff: a Tier-1 escalation. refusal: one of purpose.refuses. deferred: recognised and explained, never acted on.

intents.description: The closed set of things a customer asks for. Rules that count or select by intent — a fact like `repeated_intent`, a direct path for exactly one intent — read this set. Without it every implementation invents its own and the rules fire in different places.

conditions.description: Named conditions for reuse. A named condition has no entity of its own, so its field must be qualified.

facet.description: Optional. A 25010:2023 sub-characteristic of the concern, where the characteristic alone is too coarse.

addressed_to.description: Who the rule governs. harness: which path answers or what a path may do, never rendered into the model's instruction. model: rendered, and enforced where `via` says. Absent: both.

^P-[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$.description: A rule in words, and the operations whose conditions enforce it. A policy no operation enforces is a preference. `rule` is rendered alone, among others, so it names its own subject.

on_condition.description: First match wins, so order is part of the specification.

personal_data_in_conversation.description: Personal data that is not a declared field. Declared fields carry `pii: true` themselves.

external.description: The contract with each system the agent depends on. The contract is domain knowledge; the transport that carries it is a binding and does not appear here.

undeclared.description: Properties this agent plainly has an answer to and nobody has written down. Stated as absent rather than left out.

concern.description: Which kind of quality this statement is about — the nine characteristics of ISO/IEC 25010:2023 plus `cost`, the family-wide axis defined in the Spec Charter §3. Authored on every statement, because unlike the harness catalog's layers and the assurance catalog's dimensions, nothing else here implies it. Drives the Concern View, which joins every artifact in the family on this string: an NFR is a statement whose concern is not functional suitability, which is why this family has no separate NFR document.

evidence.description: Charter §6: every MUST names how it is demonstrated.

of.description: An enum whose values are the states of a named state machine.

advances.description: A counter that runs with world time, so a window can close while a conversation is still open.

advances_when.description: When the counter runs. Absent means always. Usually the invariant that says when the field may be non-zero, pointed forwards.

untrusted.description: Written by someone other than the system. Content, never instruction.

fresh_for.description: How long a read of this field stays usable. Declared where something else writes the field while a conversation is open — the entity's `concurrent_writers` is the tell — and applied by the harness only where an irreversible operation's preconditions reach the field (AHC-0107). A field with no window never causes a re-read, which is the correct amount of work for a field nothing irreversible depends on.

because.description: Why the combination cannot exist. Quoted when a seeded row breaks it.

invariants.description: Which combinations of fields can coexist — what the world can BE, not what it permits.

from.description: A state, a list of states, or `any_except_terminal`.

by.description: An operation, or `external` for a change something else makes.

condition.description: The vocabulary the world, the omission oracle and the escalation rules share, plus `equals_session`. Bounds are numbers, so money compares. A rule needing more — arithmetic across fields, OR, a quantifier — is the signal to adopt an expression language for all of them at once, not to add a second syntax here.

side_effect.description: What repeating it costs. Irreversible means repeating charges someone twice.

input.description: An input `<entity>_id` on an operation over that entity names the row it acts on and is carried as the entity's `key`: that key name is the one the model is shown and the far end enforces. Every other input travels under its own name.

output.description: The entity returned. `entity[]` is a read of many rows: it takes no key, and must be scoped to the caller by a precondition over the session.

amount_from.description: Where a money amount comes from. Never the conversation.

oneOf.description: Field → new value. `$name` means the input of that name.

identity.description: The DOMAIN meaning of "the same request". How a key is derived and carried belongs to the harness.

owed_when.description: Owed, not merely permitted. Without it an omission is invisible to every other check.

on_refusal.description: What to offer instead. The reason and the offer, never the wording.

kind.description: undo: the prior state is restored. counteract: a second action offsets it, and both stay on the record. none: nothing can, stated rather than implied.

how.description: The compensating path in domain terms, or why there is none.

compensation.description: AHC-0058, per operation. Required of every write: knowing an action cannot be undone changes whether it should run unattended.

offered.description: Absent or true: in the model's tool set. False: never shown to the model, reached only through another operation's `routes_to` or by a person.

routes_to.description: The operation this one leads to when its conditions allow: a request that becomes an action. The target's `authority` decides whether it runs now or waits for a person.

values.description: A declared set the statement draws on, such as the outcomes a close may record.

statements.description: Normative lines, each with the id a test names to discharge it, each carrying its own parameter where it has one. Prose beside a parameter is two statements of one rule and they drift; prose with no id is a rule the Assurance Map cannot see, which is how this agent's escalation and approval rules went unverified while reading as specified.

excluded.description: Excluded, not "not applicable". An exclusion that names the change that would revoke it cannot quietly become permanent.

settled.description: Where this spec and the catalog were read as disagreeing, and how it was settled. Neither an exclusion nor a claim: the obligation holds, and this is what it was taken to mean here. Undocumented, the same question is re-argued by every reader and the answer drifts.
